# Nav Header

The UI-shell navigation header that guides users through a site. It appears at the top of every page and holds the platform logo, primary menu items (with optional sub-menu dropdowns), and action buttons. Adapts across desktop (>960), tablet (600–960), and mobile (<600) breakpoints, supports contained or full-width layouts, and mirrors fully for RTL. Modeled on Figma frames 30150:148751 (Nav Header), 148312 (Menu Item), 148445 (Action), 148860 (Menu), 148877 (Sub-menu), 148183 (Sub-menu Item), 148742 (Item Icon).

**Stylesheet:** `components/nav-header/nav-header.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/nav-header.js` (classes `NavHeaderManager`); wired through `[data-submenu]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

The classes and JS hooks that compose the navigation header.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.navigation-header` | Container | 72px-tall header bar with a left section (logo + menu) and right section (actions). |
| `.logo-placeholder` | Slot | Platform logo + label at the leading edge. |
| `.navigation-menu` | Slot | The primary menu bar holding .header-menu-item links. |
| `.header-menu-item` | Item | A menu link. Add --selected for the active state, --disabled to disable, and data-submenu="ID" to attach a dropdown. |
| `.header-action` | Item | Action button. Variants: --outline, --primary, --icon-only. Plus --selected / --disabled states. |
| `.header-sub-menu` | Dropdown | Panel opened by a menu item. Add .is-open to show, --full for a mega-menu, --brand for the green panel. |
| .header-sub-menu-group / __label | Slot | A column of sub-menu items with an optional group label. |
| `.header-sub-menu-item` | Item | Icon + label + optional helper text link inside the dropdown. |
| `.header-menu-toggle` | Trigger | Hamburger button shown on tablet/mobile breakpoints. |
| `data-submenu="ID"` | JS hook | On a menu item — toggles the .header-sub-menu with that id (click outside / ESC closes). |

## Menu Item

States per Figma 30150:148312. Default, hover (gray fill + gray indicator pill), selected (green fill + light-green indicator), and disabled. Each item can carry a dropdown chevron.

```html
<div class="nav-header-preview">
    <header class="navigation-header" style="position: static;">
        <div class="navigation-header__left">
            <nav class="navigation-menu" role="menubar">
                <a href="#" class="header-menu-item header-menu-item--selected" role="menuitem"><span class="header-menu-item__text">Selected</span><svg class="header-menu-item__arrow" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M6 9L12 15L18 9"></path>
                    </svg></a>
                <a href="#" class="header-menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="header-menu-item__text">Default</span><svg class="header-menu-item__arrow" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M6 9L12 15L18 9"></path>
                    </svg></a>
                <a href="#" class="header-menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="header-menu-item__text">Hover me</span><svg class="header-menu-item__arrow" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M6 9L12 15L18 9"></path>
                    </svg></a>
                <a href="#" class="header-menu-item header-menu-item--disabled" role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true"><span class="header-menu-item__text">Disabled</span><svg class="header-menu-item__arrow" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M6 9L12 15L18 9"></path>
                    </svg></a>
            </nav>
        </div>
    </header>
</div>
```

## Header Action

Action button variants per Figma 30150:148445. Outline (default), primary (green filled), and icon-only. Click toggles the selected state on outline actions.

```html

                    <path d="M9 12H15"></path>
                    <path d="M12 9L15 12L12 15"></path>
                </svg><span>Icon</span></a>
            <a href="#" class="header-action header-action--primary">
                <svg class="header-action__icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
```

## Responsive (Mobile)

Below 900px (the library's 56.25em breakpoint) the menu and outline actions hide, a hamburger appears at the start, the branding centers, and the menu opens as a full-width panel under the header — exactly the NDS dga-header behavior. The platform header above behaves this way live; resize the window to try it.

```html
<div>
    <header class="navigation-header navigation-header--mobile-demo">
        <button type="button" class="header-menu-btn" aria-expanded="true" aria-label="Open menu">
            <span class="icon dga-icon-menu-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="navigation-header__left">
            <div class="logo-placeholder">
                <svg class="logo-placeholder__icon" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                    <rect width="48" height="48" rx="4" fill="#F5F5F5"></rect>
                </svg>
                <span class="logo-placeholder__text">Platform Logo</span>
            </div>
            <nav class="navigation-menu"></nav>
        </div>
        <div class="navigation-header__right">
            <a href="#" class="header-action header-action--primary"><span>عربي</span></a>
        </div>
    </header>
    <div class="header-mobile-menu">
        <a href="#" class="header-menu-item header-menu-item--selected" onclick="return false;">
            <span class="header-menu-item__text">Home</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#" class="header-menu-item" onclick="return false;">
            <span class="header-menu-item__text">Styles</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#" class="header-menu-item" onclick="return false;">
            <span class="header-menu-item__text">Components</span>
        </a>
        <div class="header-mobile-menu__actions">
            <a href="#" class="header-action header-action--outline" onclick="return false;"><span>About
                    Team</span></a>
            <a href="#" class="header-action header-action--outline" onclick="return false;"><span>Search</span></a>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```
